balls.text: just a single, and MI finish with 180! Nails the wide yorker, more or less, and prevents SKY from getting under it. He throws his hands at it and slices it on the bounce to deep backward point. SKY takes off his helmet and walks off to applause, even as the Capitals fielders around him try to fathom what has hit them!

stop that, Suryakumar Yadav! This is batting out of the highest of top drawers! This is the perfect yorker outside off but SKY is just too good. He opens his bat face and squeezes it to the keeper's right!

oh my goodness - the Mumbai mayhem continues! And this is proper world-class batting! Another missed yorker and this time, it ends up as a low full toss just outside off. SKY gets down low and clubs the living daylights out of this one. Flat over deep mid wicket!
NASA, lend us a space shuttle, because we need to get that ball back! Off-pace on a back of a length outside off and this is begging to be hit. SKY obliges and smears it a mile over deep mid wicket!
low full toss on middle and leg, and SKY misses out. Chalks it right off the toe-end and shanks it towards mid wicket

why should Naman Dhir have all the fun, asks Suryakumar Yadav! Chameera does not help himself or his team by bowling a wide half-volley. SKY gets his hands through the ball and thunders it over extra cover!

blitzed across the turf, and the Wankhede Stadium has found its voice all of a sudden! Right in the slot outside off. Dhir opens up his stance, gives his hands the freedom to go through the line and scorches it past extra cover!

a high ball and to MI's pleasure, it is a long enough ball too! Slower bumper outside off. No pace to work with for Dhir but he swings his blade like an axe. Gets under it but still manages to muscle it over Rizvi at long on. Rizvi might have misjudged it slightly and had to thus reach out over his shoulder, only managing a parry over the fence!
flat as a tank! Dhir, SKY and MI are turning it on now! Another missed yorker and this is into the slot on leg stump. Dhir snaps his wrists into action and whips it over the wide long on fence!
oh, hello! Dhir wants a piece of Mukesh too! A bit on the shorter side and this sits up outside off. Dhir rises with the bounce, stands tall and crashes it over extra cover!
back of a length wide outside off. SKY shuffles across, gets stopped half-way trying to get into position for the sweep and hacks it in an ungainly fashion to deep mid wicket

SKY with a sumptuous shot to bring the crowd to their feet! This is an attempted wide yorker but ends up being a slot ball. SKY extends his arms fully and creams it over extra cover. A fifty under pressure and while this may not be his most fluent effort ever, it may be very important!
slow and short outside off. SKY waits for it and cuts it towards sweeper cover. Just six off the over, and this MI innings is in dire need of some impetus
off-cutter angled across the batter on a back of a length. Well outside off and SKY, because of the lack of pace, cannot fetch it. Swish and a miss.
SKY with a much-needed boundary! Misses the leg-stump yorker by a smidgen on the shorter side, and SKY makes the bowler pay. Swings through the line and thumps it past a flying du Plessis at mid on!
back of a length wide outside off. SKY looks for one of those slashes over point but the lack of pace does for him
dug into the track just outside off. Dhir backs away and has to check his shot because the ball just does not arrive. Chips it on the bounce to long off
back of a length, slanting across the batter outside off. Dhir gets up on his toes and pats it towards backward point
speared in full and wide. SKY tries to reach it and make something of it but is beaten for pace. That was not a slower ball, and it seemed to take the batter by surprise
back of a length just outside off. Cramped for room, Dhir stabs it towards long on

off-pace on a back of a length outside off. Dhir plays it very late and right under his eyes, guiding it to backward point's right. Tiwari, stationed at sweeper cover, gives chase and cuts it off with a sprawling dive, saving two

well, Hardik tries, and Hardik perishes, much to the disappointment of thousands at the Wankhede! Another leg-cutter but the difference this time is the line and the length. This is just outside off and full enough for Hardik to think he can go downtown. Goes through with his swing but the grip and hold off the surface means he slices it straight down backward point's throat. Hardik walks off dejected, and MI slide further into trouble!
excellent yorker outside off. SKY jams down on it and squeezes it out towards deep backward point

SKY finds the gap, and finds the fence! Attempted leg-cutter but this is too short and too wide to be a useful option. SKY waits on it and opens the bat face at the last moment to glide it between backward point and short third!
googly on a length outside off. Hardik reads it off the pitch and tentatively prods it towards backward point
floated up full just outside off. SKY gets down on one knee and hacks it towards deep mid wicket
fired in fuller on the pads. Hardik gets down on one knee and paddles it towards short fine leg
slower and fuller outside off. SKY plants his front foot and powers it down the ground to long on
shortish on middle and off. Hardik hops back and punches it towards long off
tossed up full on middle and leg. Hardik lunges forward and....blocks
back of a length outside off. Hardik presses half forward and dabs it into the point region to get off the mark

straight to long on, and Tilak's struggles come to an end! Dug into the track outside off, asking Tilak to fetch it leg side. He swings at it with all his might but cannot quite generate the power he is after. Might have been the slower ball too, which made it tougher for the batter and Tilak could not have picked out Rizvi better. DC have something to show for their middle-overs squeeze, and MI, just as the death-overs are dawning, lose a set batter!
a wide yorker is the answer. SKY moves across his stumps to access it and clinks it out towards deep backward point

massive lbw shout, not given! Darted in very full in and around off stump. SKY makes a hash of the sweep again and gets rapped on the pads. Impact may have been outside off, but DC review nevertheless. Might be a review in hope rather than anticipation. Looks like SKY has missed the ball completely. But Ball Tracking, as expected, reckons the impact was outside off. SKY stays, and DC lose a review!
oh! On-pace yorker just outside off. SKY looks for that trademark sweep of his but is beaten for pace. That zipped under his bat!
and that is exactly what SKY does first ball! Half-tracker on leg stump and this sits up to be hit. SKY picks the length early and pummels it into the deep mid wicket fence!
on the stumps again, denying SKY any sort of room. He lets this length ball come to him before tapping it into the off side
fetch that, says SKY! Another slower ball on a back of a length, finishing just outside off. This time, though, SKY has it all worked out. Dances down the track and clobbers it flat over long off!
another slower ball and this takes a couple of business days to arrive. SKY has a swipe at it and gets pinged on the back leg. Pitched outside leg, and hence no lbw shout
another off-cutter, on a back of a length and finishing just outside off. Not enough room to work with and SKY cuts it straight to backward point
off-pace on a back of a length outside off. Tilak waits for it and dabs it towards backward point
cutter on a back of a length on off. SKY looks to work to leg but gets turned inside out by the angle across him. Off the leading edge towards sweeper cover
googly on a back of a length on middle and off. SKY reads it off the surface and works it towards deep mid wicket
back of a length just outside off. Tilak hangs back and pokes it towards deep mid wicket
follows the batter outside leg with a back of a length ball. Tilak drops down to one knee and swings it away towards deep backward square leg
fired in quicker on a full length on middle and off. Tilak wants to tip and run to extra cover but there was never a single there
this is fuller on leg stump and Tilak, advancing to manufacture something, ends up yorking himself. Jams it off the inside edge into his boot
tossed up full on middle and off. Tilak stretches forward and defends
back of a length on leg stump. Tilak stays back and helps it round the corner to keep strike
flighted up full just outside off. SKY brings out the sweep, rolls his wrists and drills it towards deep backward square leg
tossed up full on middle and leg. Tilak lunges at it and prods it off the inside half of the bat towards short fine leg
full outside off. SKY gets down on one knee and sweeps it towards short fine leg
googly on a length on middle and leg. Tilak reads it off the pitch and bunts it to the bowler's left
googly on a back of a length on leg stump. Tilak is unsure of where this is turning and dangles his bat. Off the leading edge towards the bowler
back of a length just outside off. Tilak lets the ball arrive before working it towards deep backward square leg

Tilak breaks the shackles with an audacious shot! Back of a length just outside off. Tilak telegraphs the line and the length, and gets down on one knee early. Keeps his eyes on the ball and laps it over the keeper's head!
leg-cutter dug into the track outside off. SKY is a little early on the pull and ends up dragging it to deep square leg
back of a length just outside off. Tilak stays back and knocks it to long on
angled across on a length outside off. Tilak presses half forward and taps it towards extra cover
hard length just outside off. SKY gets up on his toes and drops it into the off side with soft hands for a single
edged and Porel gets nutmegged! Shortish outside off. Tilak hops back and swipes across the line. Only manages a faint tickle and the ball flies through Porel before he can react!
safe again! Slower and fuller on middle and off. SKY looks for the sweep and does not get all of it. Hoicked away towards deep backward square leg, who does well to save three
ripper! Fizzed in on a back of a length. Pitches just outside off and then grips in the surface to spin considerably. Whizzes past the outside edge
on a length on middle stump. SKY gets caught on the crease and pokes it towards extra cover
floated up full outside off. Tilak gets fully forward and tugs it towards long on. Calls for two initially but that was hit too firmly to make that a possibility
back of a length on leg stump. SKY goes back and pushes it towards deep mid wicket
full on middle and off. SKY gets a good stride in and pushes it towards long on
shortish on middle and leg, and Tilak cannot put it away. Hops back and heaves it straight to deep backward square leg
tossed up full on leg stump. Tilak plonks his front foot and looks to defend. Does not pick the googly, though, and plays down the wrong line, getting rapped on the front pad
back of a length, sliding down leg. Tilak fails to get bat on it and the umpire calls it a wide
very similar to the last ball. Full on middle and leg. Tilak wants to nudge this past the keeper but is unable to do so for the second ball running. Good, sharp work by Porel, it must be said
fuller on the pads. Tilak nurdles it into the square leg region and his attempt at a single is thwarted by Porel

looped up full just outside off. Tilak stretches forward and nibbles at it. Gets a thick outside edge that evades short third, and Tilak can get back for two. Kuldeep and Mukesh (who tried fielding this ball) may not be on best talking terms at the moment
back of a length outside off. Skids off the surface and Tilak, sitting back in his crease, stabs it to long on

given more air on a length outside off. SKY looks for the sweep but because he is not to the pitch of the ball entirely, it spins enough to go past his bat and rap him on the body. Gets a leg bye to short third
back of a length on the stumps. Tilak goes back and turns it towards deep mid wicket. The call was for two initially but both batters decided against it
floated up full and wide. SKY reaches out for it and drives it towards sweeper cover
flighted up nicely on a full length on leg stump. Tilak lunges forward and helps it round the corner behind square on the leg side
back of a length just outside off. Tilak reads the googly off the pitch and defends off the back foot
done with surgical precision! Kuldeep offers a hint of width and errs on the shorter side, and the scalpel is out. SKY hangs back and then knifes it between backward point and short third!
googly on a back of a length just outside off. Tilak lets the ball come to him before easing it to deep mid wicket

in the air again, and taken this time! Rickelton throws his head back in disappointment, and the mood turns even more somber at the Wankhede Stadium! Given a bit of air again, daring Rickelton to bring out the sweep and nail it. He takes up the challenge but comes up second-best. Not quite to the pitch of the ball, meaning that he chalks it off the toe-end. Tiwari, on debut, runs around to his right from deep backward square leg, and snares the chance. Kuldeep is delighted, as is du Plessis, and this is a vital wicket at this stage!

miscued and it just evades Mukesh Kumar! Tossed up nicely on a fullish length just outside off. SKY looks for the sweep and gets a top edge. The ball floats in the air and falls agonizingly to Mukesh's left at short fine leg. He went at it with both hands but could not get there
back of a length just outside off. Rickelton hangs back and jabs it towards extra cover
very full on the pads. Rickelton uses the angle and flicks it away to long on's left. du Plessis hunts it down but cannot prevent two
shot! Slower ball that lands as a half-volley outside off. SKY picks the variation early, lines it up and smashes it back past the bowler!
into the blockhole on middle and leg. SKY gets behind the line of the ball and digs it out towards mid on
through Nigam, and SKY is off the mark! Full outside off. SKY gets onto the front foot and drives it towards mid off. An uncharacteristic misfield and SKY gets two for his toil

goes a mile up, and it nestles into Nigam's palms! The slower ball does the trick for Mukesh. Full just outside off and Jacks is enticed into a big hack across the line. The lack of pace, though, means he cuts across it too much and Nigam, back-pedaling from mid off, keeps his eyes on the ball all the way and does the rest. MI lose two in the powerplay, and DC keep chipping away!
back of a length on leg stump. Rickelton backs away and stabs it towards mid off for a quick single

appeal for an lbw, not given! Low full toss slanted into leg stump. Jacks misses his swish and the ball raps him on the front pad. Was perhaps heading down leg, though. UltraEdge indicates there was bat involved too
on-pace, into the blockhole on leg stump. Jacks jams down on it and flicks it towards long on
high into the Mumbai night sky and deep into the stands! Looks like another slower ball and this pitches in the slot on the pads. Jacks picks it up early enough and dumps it over deep square leg!

safe, and Jacks gets four for his troubles! Another superbly-disguised off-cutter, pitching on a length outside leg. Jacks has a swish at it and gets the ball diametrically opposite to where he was aiming. Sliced over backward point!
devilish off-cutter, pitching well outside leg, as a riposte to Jacks backing away.. He tries to dab it behind point but is beaten by the lack of pace. Deceived completely
slower ball on a length just outside off. Rickelton comes forward, waits for it and knocks it to long on
back of a length outside off. Rickelton hangs back and jabs it towards cover point
catch it is the call, but no one is going to catch that! Half-tracker on middle and off, and Jacks makes the most of it. Rocks back and pounds it to mid on's right!
more spin! Back of a length, pitching on off and then spinning away appreciably. Jacks gets a leading edge towards the bowler
peach! Fizzed through on a length outside off. Drifts into Jacks before gripping in the surface and ragging past the outside edge
up and over! A bit of a drag-down outside off. Sits up nicely for Jacks and even though he does not middle it completely, he gets enough to clear mid on. One bounce and into the fence!
back of a length just outside off. Jacks goes back and prods it towards extra cover
googly on a fullish length on the pads. Rickelton nudges it into the on side and picks up an easy single
hard length just outside off. A bit of nip back in and Rickelton, slightly cramped for room, stabs it into the mid wicket region
full just outside off. Rickelton gets onto the front foot and turns it towards mid wicket
back of a length on middle and off. Jacks tips it to mid off and hares across to the other end to get off the mark
back of a length, pushed across the batter outside off. Jacks goes feeling for it with minimal foot movement and gets beaten on the outside

edged and gone! Rohit bites the dust, and the Wankhede Stadium descends into silence! Angled across on a length outside off. Rohit goes chasing after it, trying to go downtown. Gets his body shape all wrong, though, and all he manages is a healthy nick through to Porel, who snaps it up smartly to his right. Rohit cannot believe what he has done, nor can the thousands clad in blue. No real celebration from the Fizz but deep down, he will know this is a big breakthrough!
full on the pads. Rickelton transfers his weight forward, rolls his wrists and helps it towards deep backward square leg
back of a length on leg stump. Rickelton lets the ball arrive before working it towards deep square leg
back of a length on leg stump. Rickelton hops up onto his toes and tucks it off his pads through square leg. Easy brace for the left-hander
this is an even better shot! Rickelton has arrived, folks! Chameera pulls his length back outside off but not by enough. Rickelton goes through the line and pops it clean over the long off fence!
up, up and away! First six of the evening! Slanted in on a fullish length and this finishes just outside off. Rickelton plants his front foot, stands tall and pumps it over the non-striker's head!
zipped into the blockhole just outside off. Rickelton jams down on it and squeezes it out towards mid wicket
superb fielding! Fullish in the channel just outside off. Rickelton gets forward and punches it strongly towards extra cover. Good work by Nigam to his left to save four
full outside off again. Rohit presses forward but this time, opts against the aggressive option. Pats it gently towards cover
glorious! Mukesh goes searching for swing and over-pitches outside off. Rohit plants his front foot, leans forward and crashes it over extra cover. One bounce and into the fence!
full on middle and off. Rickelton gets a good stride forward and drives it crisply towards mid off, who snaps down sharply to his left and keeps it to one
angled in on a length on middle and leg. Rohit presses half forward and pats it into the mid wicket region to get off the mark
full and wide outside off. Rohit reaches out for it and times it sweetly. Cannot beat the fielder at cover point, though
full and swinging into the pads. Rickelton comes forward and flicks it enough to mid on's left to get off the mark

From the brink of despair last season and early this campaign, to pure elation and ecstasy - the Mumbai Indians, five-time winners already, are now eleven-time qualifiers! This brilliantly bullish band in blue and gold, away from the big time for a gruelling year that may have felt like an eternity, will be back in the thick of it all in 2025! And this stellar star cast, of Boult and Bumrah, of Tilak and SKY, of Chahar and Dhir and Santner, and of Rickelton, Rohit and the redemption-chasing Hardik, will have yet another opportunity to add to this league's legend and to this franchise's folklore, and to show how and why this team just gets winning better than most in the land! And this blow is fitting of how dominant MI have been since over number 18 in the first innings. A searing yorker on middle stump. Straight as an arrow and Mustafizur, batting at eleven, had absolutely no chance of keeping that out. Smiles, embraces and plenty of flag-waving in the stands. The MI crowd turned up tonight, and their side turned up tonight too. And the Capitals, well, they will be left ruing what could have been, and a failure to win yet another game that really, really mattered in an IPL season!
zipped in full on middle and leg. Chameera swings at it becuase, why not, and chips it down to long on

goes straight up, and Kuldeep goes straight back to the shed! Karn dangles the carrot on leg stump and Kuldeep bites. Scampers down the track to try and smash it into the Arabian Sea but gets nowhere near the pitch of the ball. Has to reach out well in front and he only gets height. Long on runs in and takes a regulation chance to leave DC tottering even more!
angled into the pads. Chameera makes his mind up early and swings for the hills, hoicking it towards deep backward square leg
on a length just outside off. Kuldeep skips down the track and flicks it towards deep mid wicket
shortish just outside off. Kuldeep hops back and pulls it to deep mid wicket's left. Gets two for his troubles
full on leg stump. Kuldeep advances and drills it back to the bowler. Might have yorked himself too
shortish on leg stump. Chameera gets onto the back foot and heaves it towards deep backward square leg
low full toss slanting into leg stump. Kuldeep gives himself a bit of room and drives it past extra cover for a couple of runs
slower ball on a full length on middle and leg. Chameera chips it towards long on and has to settle for a single
slower bumper on leg stump. Chameera has a swipe at it but does so too early. Misses it altogether
full on middle and off. Kuldeep backs away and flays it towards sweeper cover
very full again, attacking the stumps. Chameera jams down on it and chunks it off the inside edge into his pads
excellent full ball on the stumps, denying Chameera any sort of room. He cannot do much with it apart from keeping it out
hard length, following Kuldeep outside leg. He advances too but gets tucked up for room. Patted down gently to mid on in the end
slower yorker just outside off. Chameera opens his bat face and runs it down to deep third
short ball on leg stump. Kuldeep hops around on his toes before fending it into the square leg region

Jasprit Bumrah, you cannot do that! This is proper champagne bowling now. Slower yorker that hangs in the air like it is being controlled by a thread. It hangs and hangs and hangs just outside off before dipping cruelly and clinically. Tiwari, playing his first-ever IPL game, has no clue and plays too early. Off stump knocked back and Bumrah greets him with a smile - a smile of a man who knows he has outwitted the batter, and that he is, quite simply, the best in the world!

sharp bumper just outside off. Gets a little big on Tiwari, who swipes at it and shanks it towards deep square leg. Both batters are intent on two and Chameera tears back to the danger end to complete it
into the blockhole on middle and leg. Chameera jams down on it and digs it out towards deep square leg
darted in full on the pads. Chameera nudges it into the square leg region and looks at his partner, who hares across and completes the run

the Kiwi wizard has the ball on a string, and the Capitals are falling like a pack of cards in front of this magician! This is a dream delivery. Plenty of air, plenty of guile, plenty of deception and plenty of world-class quailty. Gets it over the eye-line and it drops on a length just outside off. By then, Ashutosh is committed to the drive away from his body, only to realize that his front foot and the ball are in different post codes. Wafts at it in hope and gets nowhere near it, with Rickelton doing the rest! DC on the brink now!
back of a length on the hips. Tiwari goes back and punches it towards long on
flighted up on a length outside off. Tiwari goes feeling for it and sees the ball whiz past the outside edge

does him all ends up, and Rizvi's cameo comes to an end! This is tossed up marvelously on a length on middle stump. Rizvi gets down on one knee and then waits. He waits and waits and waits and waits and then the ball arrives, along with a bit of turn and a bit of bounce. Swipes at thin air and hears the death rattle of middle stump soon after. Brilliant, brilliant bowling and Santner has two!
zinged in very full and following the batter outside leg. Rizvi attempts to go downtown but only chunks it off the inside edge into his boot
off-pace again, and a little more at the body. Rizvi stands tall to this short ball and swipes it away towards deep backward square leg, keeping strike in the process
fullish on middle and off. Ashutosh jabs it towards extra cover and saunters across to the other end
another top yorker, right on off stump. Rizvi jams down on it and clinks it down the ground for a single
nails the wide yorker and it has the beating of Rizvi. He advances, trying to dig it out, but sees the ball squirm under his flailing blade
that has sped to the fence! Slower ball dug into the track outside off. Sits up and Rizvi has all the time in the world to swat it past deep mid wicket!
back of a length just on middle and off. Ashutosh stays leg side of the ball and jabs it towards deep point
edged and four! Slower ball on a shortish length wide outside off. Rizvi gives it the lot and gets a thick outside edge that trickles away past short third!
back of a length outside off. Rizvi takes a step down the track and slaps it straight to extra cover. Scuffed that a little, it must be said
oh wow - what timing! Full on the pads and Rizvi takes full toll. Uses his wrists to perfection and clips it delightfully between deep mid wicket and deep square leg!
back of a length on middle and off. No real room to work with and Rizvi stabs it back towards the bowler, who collects sharply to his left
back of a length on the stumps. Holds a little in the surface and Ashutosh knocks it to long off
back of a length outside off. Ashutosh stands tall and cracks it off the back foot past extra cover. Dhir tracks it down from sweeper cover, sprawls to his right and saves two
back of a length, following the batter outside leg. Comes in with the arm too and Rizvi can only jam it off the inside edge into his pads
almost a spectacular grab! Angled in full on leg stump. Rizvi backs away and then smashes it straight back at the bowler. Santner flings out his left mitt but cannot make it stick
fired in fuller just outside off. Ashutosh hangs back and drives it towards sweeper cover

another absolute corker! Lobbed up deliciously on a length on middle and off. Drfits in and then rags away sharply past the outside edge. Ashutosh over-balances a touch as well, with Rickelton whipping of the bails. Not as quick as earlier in the evening, though, and Ashutosh stays!
back of a length outside off. Ashutosh hangs back and prods it towards point. Rizvi hares down for the run, only to be sent back in the nick of time
slowed up on a back of a length on leg stump. Rizvi, having backed away early, has to wait for it before working it towards deep mid wicket

this is right out of the screws, and Ashutosh is saying this game ain't finished yet! Another floaty delivery wide outside off. Within Ashutosh's arc and he uses his long levers to bulldoze it over long off!
on a length on the pads. Rizvi glances it towards short fine leg

Jacks misjudges it, and offers Rizvi a lifeline! Given plenty of air on a full length on middle and leg. Rizvi looks to go downtown and cuts across it terribly. Jacks runs in, seems to have it under control until...he does not have it under control. Over-runs it badly and the ball goes through his hands in the end!
back of a length on middle and off. Ashutosh hops back and punches it towards sweeper cover
Ashutosh lands his first blow! Tossed up on middle and off. Ashutosh comes out of his bunker and slugs this to long on's right. Much-needed runs!
angled in on a length on leg stump. Comes in with the arm and Ashutosh gets rapped on the pads after playing down the wrong line
shortish on the hips. Ashutosh gets inside the line and helps it down to fine leg, who has been placed very fine, it must be added
slower ball on a full length outside off. Ashutosh comes forward and pushes it towards extra cover
sharp bumper, angling into middle and off. Ashutosh looks for the upper-cut but is beaten by the skid Bumrah generates off the surface
hard length, slanting into middle stump. Ashutosh, caught on the crease, stabs it towards mid wicket

plumb with a capital P, and Stubbs has to head back for an early shower! But hang on. Hang on. Stubbs has reviewed! Slower ball on a fullish length, pitching just outside off and cutting back in sharply. Stubbs plays all around it and gets smoked on the front pad, right on the knee roll. This seems like a review in hope the longer it goes on, and Ball Tracking confirms that suspicion, with the ball smashing into leg stump two-thirds of the way up. Bumrah did not even look back at the umpire until very late and now, we know why. Bumrah doing what Bumrah does, and MI are squeezing the life out of this run-chase!
hard length just outside off. Stubbs gets up on his toes and dabs it towards backward point
clean as a whistle! Floated up full and wide, and Rizvi climbs into it. Free swing through the line and he pumps this over the wide long off fence!
back of a length outside off. Stubbs goes back and cuts it towards sweeper cover
full outside off. Rizvi winds up and drills it down the ground towards long off. Good work by Jacks to keep it to a single
fizzed in full on middle and leg. Stubbs stretches forward and pokes it towards long on to get off the mark
back of a length on the stumps. Rizvi opens up his stance a little more this time and punches it to long on
back of a length on middle and leg. Rizvi hangs back and taps it towards extra cover

the softest of dismissals, and Santner is weaving a web around the Capitals now! Fired in on a back of a length on middle and leg. Comes in with the arm, while also stopping in the surface a little. Nigam has designs to turn this to leg but the ball sticks in the surface just enough to induce a tame leading edge. Perhaps the easiest catch Santner will ever have to take, and DC are now four down!
full on middle and leg. Nigam gets a good stride in and smothers any possible spin
peach! Slowed up beautifully on a length just outside off and this drifts in before gripping and ripping away. Nigam beaten all ends up
tossed up generously on a full length on the pads. Rizvi lunges forward and works it towards deep mid wicket
back of a length, angling into leg stump. Skids onto the batter too, who stabs it back towards Santner
big turn! Very slow on a shortish length on leg stump. Spins an absolute mile and Rizvi can only play it back to the bowler
another rare loose ball. A full toss on middle and off. Rizvi shuffles across and helps it down to fine leg. Rizvi is hell-bent on the second but Nigam sends him back
attempted slower yorker that ends up as a dipping low full toss outside off. Rizvi flicks it straight to mid wicket
hard length at the stumps. Rizvi wants to drop and run into the square leg region but Nigam is not at all interested. Rizvi not best pleased with his partner's response
on a length just outside off. Rizvi presses half forward and prods it towards mid off
short and put away! The direction goes awry and this slides a little down leg. Rizvi steps inside the line early and swings it away fine!
off-pace on a full length on middle and leg. Rizvi nearly falls across but does enough to stab it towards mid wicket

Rohit drops an absolute sitter - oh my! Floated up full on middle and off. Nigam backs away and throws the plumbing at it. Slices it straight to short third and Rohit makes an absolute hash of it. That should have been gobbled up every day of the week!
flighted up very full on leg stump. Rizvi gives himself a bit of room and knocks it to long off
back of a length on middle and off. Rizvi hangs back and pokes it towards extra cover
back of a length on leg stump. Rizvi backs away and pushes it towards mid on
angled in fuller and quicker on the pads. Nigam nudges it enough to mid wicket's right for a single
Vipraj Nigam does not care about reputations, though! Dragged down on middle and leg. Nigam rocks back, opens up his front hip and boshes it over mid wicket!
darted in full just outside off. Nigam gets down on one knee and sweeps it towards deep mid wicket
14 off three balls! Fired in on a back of a length outside off. Nigam uses the pace on offer and dabs it fine with the deftest of touches!
four more! Nigam is counter-punching! Given a bit of air outside off. Nigam dances down the track and whips it over mid off rather nonchalantly!
Nigam makes MI pay! Short, wide and asking to be hit, especially with everyone up on the off side. Nigam throws his hands at it and carves it over cover!

back of a length outside off. Spins back in and Nigam, hanging deep in his crease, defends it behind point. Uh-oh, a No ball has been called, and DC will have a Free hit because there weren't enough fielders on the off side. Oh dear!

beauty! This is looped up deliciously on a length just outside off. Porel is drawn into a poke forward and gets beaten completely. Seems to over-balance too. Rickelton whips off the bails but has he done so quickly enough. Oh well. Oh well. The third umpire Chris Gaffaney has multiple looks at it and reckons the back foot was just in the air when the bails were taken off. What a delivery, and what a piece of keeping. Porel done all ends up, and DC staring down the barrel now!
and he finds spin straightaway! Ripping off-break, pitching on a length on middle and off and spinning away sharply. Porel is opened up like a deck chair and edges it down to short third
off-pace on a back of a length just outside off. Rizvi gets up on his toes and taps it gently towards mid wicket
Rizvi is up and running! Short ball on middle and leg. Rizvi tracks the line early, steps inside it and helps it over the short fine leg fielder!
slower ball on a full length on the pads. Porel works it towards deep backward square leg
back of a length outside off. Porel gets onto the front foot and punches it neatly past cover point for a couple of runs
off-pace again and fuller outside off. Porel is too early into his flick and plonks it on the bounce to mid wicket
slower ball on a fullish length just outside off. Porel comes forward and drives it straight to mid off
back of a length on off. Rizvi gets up on his toes and drops it into the off side. He wants the single but gets sent back early
sharp bumper just outside off. Rizvi thinks about the pull initially before bailing out of the stroke at the last moment

A Boult from the blue, and Rahul falls, and it is a racket out there at the Wankhede Stadium now! Scrambled-seam, angling across the batter on a back of a length outside off. Rahul skips down the track and then has an agricultural swipe across the line. The top hand comes off the bat, and the ball kisses the bottom part of the blade. Rickelton stoops forward and low, and gobbles it up to send KLR back to the hut!
back of a length outside off. Porel opens his bat face and guides it towards deep backward point
back of a length on middle and leg. Rahul works it towards deep square leg and gets off strike

another edge, but in the gap again! Back of a length outside off. Rahul goes fencing at it and even though he does so with an open bat face, he is not entirely in control of that stroke. Bisects backward point and short third, and gets four!
length ball on the pads. Porel presses forward and tucks it away enough to fine leg's right to bag a brace
banged into the track just outside off. Porel gauges the line and the length early enough and sways out of the way

straight to Santner, and du Plessis cannot believe what he has done! Slower ball on a full length just outside leg. du Plessis thinks he can go downtown but does not get the better of his former CSK teammate. Too early into the stroke and the bat face closes upon impact too. A tame lob to long on, and Santner was not going to drop that - not in a million years. Chahar is pumped. MI are pumped. The crowd is pumped. DC, under the pump early!
back of a length on leg stump. Rahul lets the ball come to him before tucking it towards deep square leg
fuller outside off. du Plessis has an ugly tug at it and drags it towards deep backward square leg
back of a length, angling into middle stump. du Plessis hangs back and drops it into the on side with soft hands

back of a length outside off. du Plessis stands up tall and chunks it towards mid off. Calls for the single and makes it, with help from a Hardik misfield. A clean connection and an accurate throw might have spelt trouble for the DC captain
hard length on off. du Plessis gets up on his toes and stabs it towards extra cover
back of a length wide outside off. du Plessis reaches out for it and jabs it towards extra cover
off the mark in pristine style! Back of a length on middle and off. du Plessis stays leg side to give himself room and rises with the bounce to punch it crisply to extra cover's left!
full and swinging into off stump. Rahul comes onto the front foot and pushes it back towards the bowler, who cannot hold on to it cleanly and parries it to mid off
edged and that flashes past short third! Length ball hung up wide outside off. Rahul throws the kitchen sink at it and gets a thick outside edge that hurtles away to the fielder's right!
